verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic coverage of OneDrive's core file operations: upload (including resumable sessions), sharing links, search, thumbnails, version history, delta change tracking and change notifications, plus a full machine-readable $metadata description. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI–API parity. Several UI-documented capabilities, such as offline 'Always keep on this device', Files On-Demand and folder backup, have no API counterpart in the pack. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or coverage matrix, API evidence for offline, Files On-Demand and backup features, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
